PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/Teeth886/Teeth886.github.io/pages"; Write-Host "Source branch: $\($r.source.branch\)"; Write-Host "Build type: $\($r.build_type\)"; Write-Host "URL: $\($r.html_url\)" } catch { Write-Host "Error: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($env:Path = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\("Path", "Machine"\) + ";" + [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\("Path", "User"\); try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/Teeth886/Teeth886.github.io/actions/runs?per_page=3" -Headers @{"Accept"="application/vnd.github+json"; "User-Agent"="PowerShell"} -TimeoutSec 10; $r.workflow_runs | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Run: $\($_.name\) | Status: $\($_.status\) | Conclusion: $\($_.conclusion\) | Created: $\($_.created_at\)" } } catch { Write-Host "Error: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($env:Path = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\("Path", "Machine"\) + ";" + [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\("Path", "User"\); try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/Teeth886/Teeth886.github.io/actions/runs?per_page=1" -Headers @{"Accept"="application/vnd.github+json"; "User-Agent"="PowerShell"} -TimeoutSec 10; $runId = $r.workflow_runs[0].id; Write-Host "Latest run ID: $runId"; $jobs = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/Teeth886/Teeth886.github.io/actions/runs/$runId/jobs" -Headers @{"Accept"="application/vnd.github+json"; "User-Agent"="PowerShell"} -TimeoutSec 10; $jobs.jobs | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Job: $\($_.name\) | Status: $\($_.status\) | Conclusion: $\($_.conclusion\)"; $_.steps | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  Step: $\($_.name\) | Status: $\($_.status\) | Conclusion: $\($_.conclusion\)" } } } catch { Write-Host "Error: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
